text:
Tormented Demons 
​
Introduction
Tormented demons are classified as demons, and can be slain with no Slayer level  requirement. They can be assigned as a task after completing While Guthix Sleeps and purchasing the ability to have them assigned, for 50 Slayer points 
​
⬥ Besides the default Tormented demon task, you can also kill them for Demons cluster tasks
​
Stats
⬥  XP per kill: 1136
⬥ Optimal kills per hour  (AFK)
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Sunken Pyramid: 200+
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Guthixian Temple: 180+
⬥ Optimal  XP per hour  (AFK)
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Sunken Pyramid: 227k+
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Guthixian Temple: 204k+
​
Desirable drops
⬥ Dragon Claws  
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log
⬥ Dragon limbs 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log
⬥ Ruined dragon armour pieces (slice, lump and shard)   
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log
​
Useful Items and Unlocks


















Owning the following increases the efficiency of your sessions, but is by no means mandatory

Items
⬥ Slayer Codex 
    • Once 50 souls are added, it can be used to teleport to the Sunken Pyramid
⬥ Demon horn necklace  and Attuned ectoplasmator 
    • Helps sustain your prayer








​
Method 1: Sunken Pyramid
Four Tormented Demon souls should be placed into a large room in the Sunken Pyramid, use Necromancy  with a blood reaver familiar and weapon poison.
​
⬥ Pray  and  / 
⬥ Sustain  with  + 
⬥ Ensure ,  and  are active at all times
⬥ Ensure  is active at all times
⬥ You do not need  as the demons are naturally aggressive
⬥ Do not use Darkness 
​
Location and How to Get there
⬥ Sunken Pyramid (either northern room, 4 spawns)
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In either large room, position yourself anywhere near the center of all the spawns
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You can teleport there with a teleport to house tablet, or with a Slayer Codex 
​

​

​

​

⬥ Sunken Pyramid
​
Method 2: Guthixian Temple
Tormented Demon can also be killed in their natural habitat - the Guthixian Temple. You may wish to use this method first to capture the 4 Ushabti souls  required for Method 1.
​
⬥ Pray  and  / 
⬥ Sustain  with  + 
⬥ Ensure ,  and  are active at all times
⬥ Ensure  is active at all times
⬥ You do not need  as the demons are naturally aggressive
⬥ Do not use Darkness 
​
Location and How to Get there
⬥ Guthixian Temple
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Teleport using the  (option 4 "Tormented Demons")
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stand in the south-east room, anywhere on the steps which captures the aggression of a Tormented Demon.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You will be pulled around due to spawns and limited ranged of  weapons.
